claim: Records stay in this browser, and demo records cannot change real records.
where: landing storage fact, privacy note, footer, README, and privacy policy
sandbox: fresh browser context; save a real home, enter ?demo=1, reset sample data, and assert separate IndexedDB databases preserve the real home

claim: Try it with sample data opens a separate, disposable sample record.
sandbox: fresh browser context; click the landing action; assert the demo IndexedDB namespace, seeded record, and reset behavior

claim: The sample record works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context; load /demo, wait for the service worker, set offline, and reload

claim: Records are not sent off this origin during the sample workflow.
where: Private by default note and pack builder
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; capture every browser request while creating a record and downloading PDF and ZIP exports

claim: The sample record creates a PDF and a ZIP with its evidence.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; download both formats and inspect the ZIP entries

claim: A password-protected AES-GCM backup rejects a wrong password and restores data with the right password.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; inspect the encrypted PBKDF2/AES-GCM envelope, reject a wrong password, and restore with the right password

claim: Pack Plus is a one-time $29 purchase for custom cover text and saved pack settings; core exports remain free.
where: landing facts and Pack Plus panel
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert the landing price and named unlocks, then use /demo to assert enabled free export controls

claim: The record tracks warranty dates and schedules the next repeating maintenance task.
where: README, assets, tasks, and next signals
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; inspect a warranty date, complete the repeating task, and assert that its next occurrence is scheduled

claim: The app uses no account, analytics, advertising, cloud sync, CDN font, or tracking request.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; capture all requests, inspect loaded script/font links, and assert that there is no account control

claim: Pack Plus stays locked until the Sociobot billing API verifies a license token.
where: Pack Plus restore form and privacy page
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; make license verification return 429 and then go offline; assert that arbitrary tokens never expose paid controls
